extracted.name: Broccoli Buffet Salad
extracted.description: This chilled broccoli salad with yogurt is perfect for a work lunch or a family gathering. Feta, red onion, and raisins add flavor add texture.
instruction_lines: Make the dressing: Mix yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice together in a 2-cup liquid measure.
Make the salad: Stir broccoli, onion, raisins, sunflower seeds, and feta together in a salad bowl.
Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.
